basis_note: Reads across this case's full built chain - DFAPTI, DFAPTA (30 paths), Lattice Atlas (5 patterns), SHM Gate (8 mechanisms applied, 1 candidate, 1 risk-provisional - the richest SHM Gate of any built case), Temporal Projection Integrity Engine, Enforcement Notice, and Advocacy Package. This is this repository's longest-running, most-corrected case (DEC-0020, NOTE-0133, RUN-0069 as of this assessment), and its own analysis is unusually candid about where it falls short - AR-025 states directly that 'a direct community evidence stream is a baseline yield gap.' That self-identified gap is reflected below rather than smoothed over.

functions.name: Enforcement
functions.definition: The methodology produces findings with evidentiary discipline sufficient to route to bodies with standing.
functions.match_note: A submission-ready Enforcement Notice exists, addressed to Kempsey Shire Council as the local water utility and client for both treatment-plant projects.

functions.name: Translation
functions.definition: Converts inaccessible governance documentation into findings legible to the people governed by it.
functions.match_note: AR-005 through AR-009 translate contaminant-specific water-safety technical material (iron, manganese, arsenic, turbidity, PFAS) into plain findings a resident can check against; AR-016 does the same for regional water-security network architecture.

functions.name: Pattern Detection
functions.definition: Documents a convergence across actors that no single actor can see.
functions.match_note: Lattice Atlas's LP-002 ('Two villages, one root architecture choice, uneven investment') is visible only by reading Willawarrin's and Bellbrook's separate treatment histories side by side - neither village's own record shows the comparison.

functions.name: Power Redistribution
functions.definition: Makes investigative power portable to any operator, no institutional backing required.
functions.status: Active - this case is a direct instance
functions.match_note: This is this repository's founding case, run by a private individual with no institutional backing, now carrying 30 analysis paths and 69 automation runs of accumulated, independently-conducted investigation.

functions.name: Lived Experience Protection
functions.definition: Classifies lived experience as primary evidence; institutional dismissal becomes a finding.
functions.status: Present but thin - gap self-identified by this case's own analysis
functions.match_note: AR-025 (Community Complaint and Lived-Experience Visibility Path) states directly that the evidence corpus is 'dominated by institutional and media records' with 'little direct, structured resident testimony,' and its own determination AR-025.4 names this explicitly: 'a direct community evidence stream is a baseline yield gap.' This function is not fully delivered here, and this case's own material says so.

functions.name: Legibility
functions.definition: Makes governance instruments understandable to the people they govern.
functions.match_note: AR-028 (Documented Compliance Versus Functional Outcome Path) makes legible the exact gap between what Council reports as compliant and what residents actually experienced.

functions.name: Containment
functions.definition: Names a structural harm mechanism so it can no longer operate invisibly.
functions.status: Active - most extensively evidenced of any built case
functions.match_note: The SHM Gate applies 8 mechanisms (Documented Compliance as Shield, Narrative Compression, Opacity by Design, Complexity as Barrier, Definitional Control, Time as Structural Harm Mechanism, Isolated Incident Framing, Compliance Snapshot as Exclusion), one candidate (Institutional-Source Evidentiary Skew), and one flagged risk (Equity Disparity Through Neutral Process).

functions.name: Temporal Inversion
functions.definition: Time loads onto the institution, not the citizen.
functions.match_note: Mechanism 10 (Time as Structural Harm Mechanism) is applied directly in this case's SHM Gate; AR-011 (Cost Escalation and Scope Variation) documents delay compounding cost and scope, not resolving it.

functions.name: Reflexive Audit
functions.definition: MAYHEM's own primitives applied to MAYHEM itself.
functions.status: Active - the most extensively demonstrated of any built case
functions.match_note: AR-021 (Evidence Quality, Preservation and Verification Architecture Path) and AR-022 (Willawarrin Population Metric Contradiction Path) are dedicated self-audit paths. This case's own decision register runs to DEC-0020 - two decades of recorded corrections, wording fixes, and re-verifications applied to its own prior output over time.

functions.name: Impossibility Demonstration
functions.definition: Converts closure of every remediation surface into evidence of structural impossibility of self-remediation.
functions.match_note: This case's paths document delay and cost escalation, not exhaustion of every remediation option. Not claimed.

functions.name: Divergence Preservation
functions.definition: Preserves disagreement rather than silently reconciling it.
functions.match_note: AR-022 (Willawarrin Population Metric Contradiction Path) and AR-029 (Open Question, Contradiction and Negative-Evidence Architecture Path) are dedicated paths for preserving exactly this kind of unresolved disagreement in the record.

citizen_tools.name: The Evidence Register
citizen_tools.definition: A blank, paper-ready, append-only template for documenting evidence.
citizen_tools.match_note: This repository's founding, longest-running evidence register, still actively maintained (69 automation runs recorded).

citizen_tools.name: The Advocacy Package
citizen_tools.definition: The complete investigation output combined with recipient guidance.
citizen_tools.match_note: Built and live, naming Kempsey Shire Council as recipient and explaining how to submit, log, and verify.

citizen_tools.name: Five-Step Primary Source Verification
citizen_tools.definition: Teaches any person to verify a finding against its primary source.
citizen_tools.match_note: Present in the Advocacy Package; AR-021's dedicated Evidence Quality and Verification Architecture path is direct evidence this discipline has been applied repeatedly, not just described once.

citizen_tools.name: Recipient Routing
citizen_tools.definition: Names bodies with standing, their legislative basis, and the remedy addressed to each.
citizen_tools.match_note: The Enforcement Notice names Council as the local water utility with a stated legislative basis for standing.

citizen_tools.name: Lived Experience Documentation Protocol
citizen_tools.definition: Teaches affected people to document their own experience as primary evidence.
citizen_tools.status: Not built - matches this case's own self-identified gap
citizen_tools.match_note: Consistent with AR-025's own finding, no standalone protocol exists in this case for residents to document their own water-quality experience directly - the case's evidence leans on institutional and media records instead.

citizen_tools.name: Reclassification Recognition Training
citizen_tools.definition: Teaches recognition of institutional reclassification patterns in real time.
citizen_tools.match_note: Not evidenced - no training artifact in this case's built material.

citizen_tools.name: Institutional Response Log
citizen_tools.definition: Logs every institutional response - date, form, content, classification.
citizen_tools.match_note: The Advocacy Package's logging section provides the template; no confirmed log entries recorded in this repository.

citizen_tools.name: Harm Narration Construction
citizen_tools.definition: Constructs evidence-anchored harm narration for different audiences.
citizen_tools.status: Not built as a standalone repository artifact
citizen_tools.match_note: The public-interest translation card for this case comes closest, but no dedicated harm-narration document exists inside the case's own six-stage chain.

citizen_tools.name: Onward Training Capability
citizen_tools.definition: Designed to be passed on by anyone who has worked through it.
citizen_tools.match_note: The Advocacy Package is written for a reader with no prior MAYHEM knowledge.

citizen_tools.name: Operator Curriculum
citizen_tools.definition: Trains operators to run MAYHEM investigations across competency grades.
citizen_tools.status: Not applicable to a single investigation
citizen_tools.match_note: This is a methodology-level tool, not something a single case produces.

citizen_tools.name: Paper-Ready Templates
citizen_tools.definition: Working instruments applying the methodology with no digital dependency.
citizen_tools.status: Not distinctly built for this case
citizen_tools.match_note: Not evidenced as a case-specific artifact beyond the general Advocacy Package content.

citizen_tools.name: Non-Allegatory Framing
citizen_tools.definition: Describes system behaviour, never attributes intent or motivation.
citizen_tools.match_note: AR-028 (Documented Compliance Versus Functional Outcome) names the gap between claim and reality without characterising Council's motives for it.

citizen_tools.name: Federation as Mutual Legibility
citizen_tools.definition: Multiple independent registers whose convergence produces legibility no single one can.
citizen_tools.match_note: This case does not cross-reference another case's register as part of its own findings, though DFAPTI-BB-FF-2026-00001 and DFAPTI-BB-LW-2026-00001 both note they run alongside it in the same locality.

citizen_tools.name: Temporal Accumulation as Citizen Power
citizen_tools.definition: Absence and delay become evidence that strengthens the citizen's case over time.
citizen_tools.match_note: AR-011's cost-escalation finding and AR-013's commissioning-status path both document delay compounding into a stronger, better-documented case rather than a weaker one.

citizen_tools.name: Cross-Domain Pattern Detection
citizen_tools.definition: Surfaces convergence across health, housing, disability and other domains for the same person.
citizen_tools.status: Adjacent match, not a clean fit
citizen_tools.match_note: AR-026 (Thunggutti Aboriginal Community Adjacency and Equity Path) and the flagged risk mechanism (Equity Disparity Through Neutral Process) touch equity across a specific community's circumstances, but this is one water-safety domain viewed through an equity lens, not literally multiple governing systems for one person.

citizen_tools.name: Community Evidence Aggregation
citizen_tools.definition: Multiple people's accounts of the same system, aggregated without institutional processing.
citizen_tools.status: Present but thin - same gap as Function 5
citizen_tools.match_note: AR-025 records 'a small number of formal customer enquiries' and complaint counts, but its own determinations state complaint counts 'are not a complete measure of lived harm' and the corpus 'cannot quantify non-reporting or complaint fatigue' - aggregation exists, but is explicitly flagged by this case's own analysis as incomplete.

citizen_tools.name: Structural Literacy as Preventative Tool
citizen_tools.definition: Lets a citizen recognise a harm mechanism before it completes.
citizen_tools.status: Not evidenced as forward-preventative for this case
citizen_tools.match_note: This case documents recurring, already-completed water-quality incidents; it is not framed as catching a new incident before it happens.

citizen_tools.name: Parallel Verification as Democratic Infrastructure
citizen_tools.definition: Any completed investigation can be independently re-verified using the same methodology.
citizen_tools.status: Active - most extensively demonstrated of any built case
citizen_tools.match_note: AR-021's dedicated verification-architecture path, and 69 recorded automation runs re-checking and extending prior findings over time, are a sustained, real instance of this tool in continuous operation.

citizen_tools.name: Yield Without Enforcement
citizen_tools.definition: Chain completion is determined by yield delivery, not enforcement notice production.
citizen_tools.status: Active - the organising principle of this page
citizen_tools.match_note: This case's DFAPTA, Lattice Atlas, and SHM Gate already deliver legibility and structural visibility regardless of whether the Enforcement Notice is ever acted on by Council.

not_claimed: This gate does not claim every catalogue entry above is fully or perfectly delivered - AR-025's own self-identified gap (Function 5, Citizen Tool 23) is reported as a gap, not reframed as a success.

This gate does not claim intent by Kempsey Shire Council or any individual. Every assessment above describes what this case's own material demonstrates, consistent with this case's non-allegatory framing throughout.
This gate does not re-verify the underlying evidence items cited - their verification status remains exactly as recorded in this case's own evidence register.
This is this repository's own reading of the catalogue against this case's material, not a claim of the operator's final or complete assessment.
